text: I do not need this right now, but I am interested next month. Please tell me the current price; do not book anything or call this a permanent rejection.

Of course. Sofa cleaning is three hundred forty nine rupees per seat, minimum three seats, and kitchen cleaning is one thousand five hundred ninety nine rupees total. Since you are interested for next month, shall I note down your enquiry for our team to review?
Yes, I am still interested in future. I am not asking you to call me later right now. What should I know about the service?
Our working hours are Monday to Saturday, from 9am to 6pm. Which service would you like to know more about, sofa cleaning or kitchen cleaning?
You have answered my questions. I do not need anything else. Goodbye, end the call.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
